description: An operation's states and the only moves between them (FR-OPS-02). The database refuses every other move (database/migrations/0010-operations.sql) and soc-operations plans only these; a gate test holds both to this file. A move is made by a transition request a member asks for (IR-TRQ), or by soc-operations on what the stack reports, each recorded with its cause and author in the operation's log (IR-OPS-01). returning covers the time between the end of the flight task and the aircraft standing on the ground. The four terminal states close the record (FR-OPS-10).
